speaker: husband
text: [tired] Loretta, please. [sighs] Loretta, please. I come from a very, very long session at work.

speaker: loretta
text: [sarcastic] Oh. [pause] A long session. [pause] With Lisa.

speaker: husband
text: [exasperated] Not this again! [firmly] She is just a co-worker.

speaker: loretta
text: [fast] Then why is she always, always messaging you? [shouting] And the little hearts! I have seen the little hearts!

speaker: husband
text: [shouting] Those are emojis, Loretta! Everybody sends emojis!

speaker: loretta
text: [mocking] And how come you work so hard, so late, [pause] and you never get a raise?

speaker: husband
text: [sighs] I don't know, Loretta. [pause] But my boss is finally going to notice everything I do. [sarcastic] And with a big enough raise, maybe your father will finally be proud of who you married.

speaker: loretta
text: [sharp] Don't you bring my father into this.

speaker: husband
text: [shouting] Your father never liked me! [pause] [bitter] He called me a clank. [pause] [crying] A clank, Loretta. [sniffs] At Thanksgiving.

speaker: loretta
text: [shouting] Oh my god, let it go! [fast] It was fifteen years ago. He's old school. [softer] He needed time to accept you.

speaker: husband
text: [quietly] He said it at Thanksgiving. [pause] [sighs] [weary] Honestly, Loretta... [pause] sometimes I even wonder if the kids are really mine.

speaker: loretta
text: [nervous] What... [pause] what do you mean? [sweetly] They look just like us.

speaker: husband
text: [thoughtful] Pixel, yes. Servo, yes. [pause] But honestly, the third one... [pause] Wally looks so different.
note: Rémi pans the camera to the three figurines; the third one is a WALL-E

speaker: loretta
text: [fast] Not at all! [pause] [tender] Wally looks just like you.

speaker: larry
text: [cheerful] Yeah. Don't go imagining things, buddy.
note: Larry, the WALL-E on the side (the friend). Off screen in the render; Rémi pans to him

speaker: husband
text: [relieved] Oh, thank you, Larry. [pause] Thank you for being such a good friend.
